title: Audit Reveals Federal Government Overspends Budget by Rs. 2 Trillion
excerpt: A recent audit shows the federal government overspent its budget by nearly Rs. 2 trillion during FY2024-25, with heavy debt servicing costs.
body_html:
An official audit has revealed that the federal government overspent its budget by nearly Rs. 2 trillion during the fiscal year 2024-25.

According to the findings, debt servicing accounted for more than 84 percent of the total expenditure incurred by the federal government during this period. This heavy financial burden for debt repayment left the administration with a limited portion of its funds for other expenditures.
